investigations.summary: 47 package jobs, CLI Generic and both GSSAPI tarball jobs expected v3's 3.10.1 but got 3.10.0: RC build pmm3-client-autobuild-amd #2479 (GIT_BRANCH=pmm-3.10.0, DESTINATION=testing) overwrote PR-BUILDS pmm-client-latest.tar.gz and the dynamic ol8/ol9 -latest tarballs at 18:07Z, and no v3 build has run since. Fix publishes -latest only from experimental builds (pushed to a jenkins-pipelines branch, no PR yet); until a v3 client autobuild runs, the next nightly fails the same way.

3 package jobs (ol8-amd64 pmm3-client_integration, ol10-arm64 auth_register, and one more) died at the epel repomd.xml download, 'All mirrors were tried': a transient EPEL mirror failure, the same as night #87.

client 3.8.0: pmm3-aws-staging-start #27339 hit the EPEL mirror mirrors.wcupa.edu with an incomplete TLS chain, so the dnf version lookup returned empty and 'dnf install pmm-client-' failed 3 times. This is the cause found on night #87; its fix 93145b5 is still only on the unmerged branch claude/quirky-bohr-f8of7d and needs a PR.

Both HA lanes died provisioning ROSA: pmm3-ha-rosa #359/#360 got an Akamai HTML error page from Red Hat SSO at 00:27-00:28Z ('Failed to create OCM connection'). The rosa builds the day before (#355-#358) passed, and SSO answers JSON again now, so this was a transient Red Hat outage.
